solution.text:
Let, sin⁡y=t⇒cos⁡ydydx=dtdx
∴ the equation becomes
xdtdx+t=1 or xdtdx=1-t
⇒dt1-t=dxx
On integrating, we get, 
-ln⁡1-t=ln⁡x+ln⁡C
or 11-t=Cx
i.e. 1-sin⁡yx=1C=λsay
